$jsonSchema.title: Ticket Tiers Schema - OWASP Compliant
$jsonSchema.description: Embedded ticket tier pricing within events (note: not a standalone collection)

_class.description: Spring Data MongoDB's type hint. Written on every document by the mapping converter, so a validator with additionalProperties:false that omits it rejects every write the application makes — silently in tests, which use a template with no validator, and totally in production.

name.description: Tier name (e.g., VIP, General Admission, Early Bird)

totalQuantity.description: Total tickets available for this tier

saleStartDate.description: When sales open for this tier

saleEndDate.description: When sales close for this tier
